title: Origin story: Chang'e
description: Chang'e was the wife of the archer Houyi, who received the elixir of immortality for shooting down nine suns. When his apprentice tried to steal it, Chang'e drank it herself to keep it from evil hands — and floated to the moon, where she dwells with the Jade Rabbit, forever apart from her husband.
